record_scope_reconstruction: Dated BGB land-admission denials of Rohingya at unnamed Ukhia/Ghumdhum sectors in November–December 2016. Reports also discuss Naf River interceptions, which are a different mode and excluded from this land record. Wider border policy coexisted with entry and later selective admission; no particular formal gate or complete frontier segment is established.

date_scope_check.qualification:
REC50-R47-003-P1: BGB-attributed land-admission denials are observed November 21 and December 1. Their first onset, intervening continuity and end are unknown; the wider policy coexisted with substantial actual entry. Naf River/sea interceptions and the separate return of people detained in 2015 are excluded. Inclusion is a government land-admission restriction, not an established closure of a particular formal gate. Exact sector binding remains unlocated.

Amnesty’s wider account reports selective humanitarian admission from late November 2016, alongside continuing pushbacks. This is a qualification of the admission regime, not an exact endpoint for the Ukhia/Ghumdhum land observations. The separately recorded UNHCR “urges open borders” webpage is dated 29 August 2017 and concerns a later displacement episode; it does not verify a 2016 reopening.
